title: ChatGPT on Mac and Lazur: which one to use for which job in 2026
metaTitle: ChatGPT on Mac vs Lazur: which job each one does in 2026
description: ChatGPT on Mac suits long chats and file uploads. Lazur suits quick questions about your screen and dictation in any app. Setup notes for 2026 inside.
intro: ChatGPT on Mac is OpenAI's desktop app for long chats, file uploads and projects. Lazur is a separate Mac app that sees your screen while you hold ⌥ ⌘, answers out loud and points at things. Use ChatGPT when the work lives in one conversation. Use Lazur when you are stuck in another app and need an answer now.
tldr: ChatGPT on Mac is now a new app called ChatGPT. The older Mac app is ChatGPT Classic.
Use ChatGPT for long research chats, file uploads and projects.
Use Lazur for quick questions about the app you are in. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask.
Hold fn in the ChatGPT message box to dictate a long prompt with Lazur.

blocks.text: What ChatGPT on Mac means in 2026

ChatGPT on Mac is now a new desktop app. On July 9, 2026, OpenAI merged its Codex tool into the main ChatGPT app. The merged app runs on Mac and Windows. The older Mac app is being renamed ChatGPT Classic. Daring Fireball and Michael Tsai's blog both covered the change on the day it happened.

That rename causes most of the confusion. Older guides, screenshots and forum posts may show the Classic app. Menus and the sidebar can look different. If a step does not match your screen, check which app is open before you assume the guide is wrong.

The new app bundles ChatGPT Work and ChatGPT Codex. The two share plug-ins. You do not need to learn Codex to use the chat side. Open the app, sign in, and start a conversation the way you always have.
How to tell which ChatGPT app you have

Size is the quickest check. Daring Fireball reports that ChatGPT Classic is about 159 MB. The new ChatGPT app is about 1.5 GB. Open Finder > Go > Applications, select the app, then press ⌘ I to see its size.

blocks.text: Check before you install

blocks.title: Do not install over Classic yet
blocks.text: Daring Fireball reports that installing the new app over the old one can remove ChatGPT Classic. An OpenAI help snippet says the new app may install alongside it. We could not open OpenAI's page. Move the old app out of Applications into another folder first, then test on your own Mac.
What your Mac needs for ChatGPT

The sources disagree on this. The Mac Install Guide says ChatGPT needs macOS 14 and an Apple silicon chip, naming M1, M2 and M3. It says the app is not available for Intel Macs. A search snippet of OpenAI's help page says Intel Macs work too. We could not open that page, so check it before you install.

To check your chip and macOS version, choose Apple menu > About This Mac. The chip name appears near the top of the window. The macOS version sits just below it. Write both down before you download a 1.5 GB app.
Lazur runs on macOS, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Windows is planned, not available. If you use both tools, check each requirement separately.
Option Space: how to open ChatGPT fast

Option Space is the shortcut most people search for. Press ⌥ Space and the ChatGPT launcher opens as a small window over other apps. The main app has to be running first. Open ChatGPT, leave it running, then use the shortcut from any app. If nothing appears, find ChatGPT in the Dock, open it, and try again.

Sources disagree on whether you can change the shortcut. The Mac Install Guide says you can change it in the app's settings. Another source says it is fixed. A third says to remap it in System Settings. Most Mac apps open Settings with ⌘ ,, so try that first. If you find nothing, open System Settings > Keyboard and look for a conflict.
When ChatGPT on Mac is the better choice

ChatGPT is built for a conversation that runs for days. You can keep one thread going, upload files, and return to the same chat later. For a research thread, a draft that needs many rounds, or a project with files, the chat window is the right place. Keep the work in one thread so the context stays together.

The scale is large. OpenAI reported 900M weekly active users and 50M paying subscribers in a March 2, 2026 post. Most usage is not work. An NBER paper from September 2025 found that non-work messages grew from 53% to more than 70% of all usage. Its authors include OpenAI employees.

So plan for a mix of work and personal questions. Use the chat window for long questions that need context. Use Temporary Chat for a one-off answer you do not want saved. The Mac Install Guide describes it as a no-memory, unsaved mode.
When Lazur is the faster choice

Lazur is for the moment you are stuck in another app. Hold ⌥ ⌘, ask your question, and Lazur answers out loud. Lazur looks at your screen only while you hold the keys. You do not need to copy text, take a screenshot or switch windows first.

Ask where something is and Lazur draws a circle and a label around it. This helps when a menu item has moved or a button shows only an icon. Ask how to do something and Lazur guides you one click at a time. It waits for each click before it moves on. You still do the clicking.
A worked example: saving a file as a PDF

Say you are in a spreadsheet app you use twice a year. You need a PDF. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask, how do I save this as a PDF? Lazur reads the window and the menu bar. It circles the File menu and waits. When the menu opens, it circles the next item. You make each click yourself.
Vague questions get long answers. Try asking, which menu saves a PDF? A specific question gets a shorter route. If Lazur circles the wrong thing, say so and ask again with the menu name you see.

Longer jobs run in the background. Ask Lazur to research a topic and it works in its own Chrome tabs through the Lazur for Chrome extension. It comes back with a summary and a report. Use that while you keep working in ChatGPT or another app.
What Lazur does not do
Lazur does not click buttons, edit your files or operate other apps for you. It is not a plugin or add-in for any app. It shows you where to click and waits for you to do it.

This matters when you ask for an action in ChatGPT. Lazur can draft the text, explain a setting or circle the button. It cannot press Send, change your account or save a file for you. Plan the last click yourself.
How to dictate a long prompt into ChatGPT

Typing a long brief is slow. Dictation is faster for a prompt with context, a list of rules, or a draft you want to change. Lazur dictation works in any app, including the ChatGPT message box. Dictation is unlimited on both paid Lazur plans.

items: Click inside the ChatGPT message box so the cursor blinks there.
Hold fn and speak the prompt in full sentences.
Release fn. Lazur types clean text at the cursor.
Read the text. Check names, numbers and dates before you send.
Press Return to send it to ChatGPT.

blocks.text: Here is a realistic case. You want a brief for a pottery class landing page. Hold fn in the message box and say what it needs: the tone, the length, the price and the Saturday class times. Lazur types it at the cursor. You read it, fix one name, and press Return. You did the thinking. Lazur did the typing.

blocks.title: Say the rules out loud
blocks.text: Dictate the format too. Try: short paragraphs, plain English, no headings. Lazur types what you say, so those rules go into the prompt along with the task.

Lazur keeps a personal dictionary, so add product names and unusual spellings there. Snippets hold text you reuse, such as a standard brief or a sign-off. Clipboard slots keep text you copy between tasks.

macOS has its own Dictation feature. If you prefer it, follow [how to dictate a prompt in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/dictate-a-prompt-in-chatgpt). If macOS Dictation and Lazur both want the fn key, open System Settings > Keyboard and set one of them to another key.
Mistakes people make with ChatGPT and Lazur

items: Thinking Lazur lives inside ChatGPT. It is a separate Mac app. It is not a plugin or add-in for ChatGPT, and no app maker is a partner.
Expecting Lazur to take the last step. It circles, points and guides you. It does not click buttons or operate other apps.
Sending dictated text unread. Speech tools mishear names. Read the prompt before you press Return.
Pressing ⌥ Space with ChatGPT closed. Open the main app first, then use the shortcut.
Following a Classic guide on the new app. Check the app name in the menu bar before you follow steps.
Trusting a screen reading without checking it. Ask a follow-up, or open the source page yourself.

blocks.text: Privacy: what Lazur and ChatGPT keep

Lazur listens and looks only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers so they can answer. Lazur says they are not stored, and that content is never used to train AI models. Lazur also keeps a memory of what you asked and did, on your Mac.

ChatGPT has its own settings for chat history, memory and data. Those controls sit in ChatGPT, not in Lazur. Before you paste sensitive text into a long thread, read [how to turn off chat history in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/turn-off-chat-history-in-chatgpt).
What Lazur costs and how the trial works

Lazur starts with a 3-day Pro trial. No credit card is needed. The trial starts the first time you open the app. Pro costs $18 a month, or $15 a month billed annually, with 150 AI actions. Power costs $120 a month, or $96 a month billed annually, with 1,000 AI actions.
Dictation is unlimited on both plans. ChatGPT pricing is set by OpenAI, so check their pricing page for current plans before you decide. See [Lazur pricing](/pricing) for the full list.
Which one to use for which job

rows: Have a long back and forth or upload files
Keep a project with files across many days
Ask about the window in front of you
Find a button in an app you rarely use
Dictate a long prompt into the message box

blocks.text: Many people use both. ChatGPT holds the long thread. Lazur handles the screen in front of you, including the ChatGPT window itself. Ask Lazur what a chart means, then paste the answer into a ChatGPT thread if the work needs more room.
Next steps with ChatGPT and Lazur

items: Check which ChatGPT app you have, and its size, with Finder > Go > Applications.
Attach a document with [how to attach a file in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/attach-a-file-in-chatgpt).
Test ⌥ ⌘ with a plain question, such as what is on my screen? Lazur answers out loud.
Get Lazur from the [download page](/download), start the trial, and try dictation in the ChatGPT box.
Compare ChatGPT's own screen features with Lazur using [how to share your screen with ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/share-your-screen-with-chatgpt-in-chatgpt).

blocks.text: Start with one small task. Pick a question you already have, run it through both tools, and keep the one that answers faster for you.

faq.question: Is Lazur built on ChatGPT?
faq.answer: Lazur uses AI models from providers to answer. It is a separate Mac app and is not affiliated with OpenAI. Lazur is not a plugin or add-in for ChatGPT.

faq.question: What is the new ChatGPT app on Mac?
faq.answer: Since July 9, 2026, the main desktop app is called ChatGPT. It merges Codex into the app and runs on Mac and Windows. The older app is now ChatGPT Classic. The new app is about 1.5 GB, while Classic is about 159 MB.

faq.question: Does ChatGPT on Mac need Apple silicon?
faq.answer: One guide says yes, with macOS 14 and Apple silicon only. A search snippet of OpenAI's help page says Intel Macs work too. OpenAI's help center could not be opened for this page, so check it before you install.

faq.question: Can I talk to ChatGPT on Mac instead of typing?
faq.answer: Dictation types your words into the message box. Hold fn with Lazur, or use macOS Dictation. Lazur answers out loud when you hold ⌥ ⌘. For ChatGPT's own voice features, check OpenAI's help center.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in ChatGPT for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur circles buttons, points at them and guides you one click at a time. You do the clicking. It does not press Send or change settings for you.

faq.question: Does Option Space open ChatGPT when the app is closed?
faq.answer: The Mac Install Guide says the main app must be running for the launcher to open. Open ChatGPT first, then press ⌥ Space.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: No. Windows is planned, not available. Lazur runs on macOS, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

faq.question: Do I need both tools?
faq.answer: No. If you mostly want quick help inside other apps, Lazur alone covers it. If you live in long chats, keep ChatGPT too.
